snippet.title: TPK | Teaser Trailer (WIP) – This Co-Op Dungeon Game Will Destroy Your Friendships 💀 | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
🕯 A cursed dungeon. Six fools. One bored Lich. Zero survivors. 🕯  

Welcome to TPK, a chaotic co-op dungeon crawler for 1–6 players with poor decision-making skills and even worse reflexes.

Wishlist now on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729800/TPK/

What is TPK?  
It’s not just another co-op game. It’s a procedurally generated deathtrap handcrafted by a bored undead architect with no concept of mercy.  

🎮 Think: Lethal Company meets Darkest Dungeon, but drunk.

You and your party of cursed idiots will…  
⚔️ Solve deadly puzzles (badly)  
🔥 Trigger traps with your face  
🧀 Steal loot you probably shouldn't  
🧟 Die, scream, betray, and blame each other  
👻 Become ghosts and haunt your friends

Teamwork is encouraged, but betrayal is inevitable.

FEATURES (or 4 ways to die screaming):  
🧙‍♂️ Chaotic co-op for 1–6 players  
🌀 Procedural dungeons that hate you personally  
💀 Monsters, traps, physics, fire, screaming  
🎭 Slapstick horror + emergent comedy  
🕯 Limited torches, cursed loot, bad decisions  

Why Wishlist on Steam?  
Because the Lich demands it.  
And it feeds the algorithm gods:  
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3729800/TPK/

🎁 Demo coming later this year. Bring friends. Or don’t. They’ll just die anyway.

Follow the chaos :
👾 Discord: https://discord.gg/uxCFmYJ7Yy
🐦 X / Twitter: https://x.com/GGTech_Studios
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ggtech_studios/

Loot like a rat. Die like a legend. Blame your friends.
